{#- PRINT FORMAT: Vendor Material Orders DocType: Vendors Reference copy of the Desk record "Vendor Material Orders" -- the DB record is the runtime source; keep this file equal to it. Rows come from the SAME endpoint, filters, search and sort as the Vendor page's Material Orders table (nirmaan_stack.api.data-table.get_list_with_count_enhanced, like its "Export all"), so the PDF lists exactly what the table shows. Query-string params (absent = all of the vendor's POs, newest first): po_filters JSON array of the table's column filters (Frappe filter list) order_by e.g. "creation desc" search_term the table's search box search_field the field the search box searches item_search "1" when that field is the item-name (JSON) search The vendor + "not Merged" filters are always added here, so a request can only narrow the list to this vendor's POs. -#} {%- set extra_filters = json.loads(frappe.form_dict.po_filters) if frappe.form_dict.po_filters else [] -%} {%- set search_term = frappe.form_dict.search_term or None -%} {%- set search_field = frappe.form_dict.search_field or None -%} {%- set res = frappe.call( "nirmaan_stack.api.data-table.get_list_with_count_enhanced", doctype="Procurement Orders", fields=["name", "status", "creation", "project_name", "amount", "total_amount", "amount_invoiced", "amount_paid", "po_amount_delivered", "amount_due"], filters=[["vendor", "=", doc.name], ["status", "not in", ["Merged"]]] + extra_filters, order_by=frappe.form_dict.order_by or "creation desc", limit_start=0, limit_page_length=0, search_term=search_term, current_search_fields=json.dumps([search_field]) if (search_term and search_field) else None, is_item_search=bool(search_term and frappe.form_dict.item_search == "1"), require_pending_items=False, to_cache=False, for_export=True, doc=None ) -%} {#- doc=None is required: frappe.call hands the endpoint the whole request form_dict, and in a real download_pdf that includes `doc` (the Vendors document object). The endpoint keeps unknown args in **kwargs and json.dumps them, which fails on a document ("not JSON serializable"). -#} {%- set pos = res["data"] if res else [] -%} {%- macro money(v) -%}{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(v or 0, 2, None, "#,##,###.##") }}{%- endmacro -%} {%- macro day(d) -%}{{ frappe.utils.formatdate(d, "dd-MMM-yyyy") if d else "" }}{%- endmacro -%} {%- set tot = namespace(amount=0, total_amount=0, amount_invoiced=0, amount_paid=0, po_amount_delivered=0, amount_due=0, inactive=false) -%} {%- for po in pos -%} {%- set tot.amount = tot.amount + (po.amount or 0) -%} {%- set tot.total_amount = tot.total_amount + (po.total_amount or 0) -%} {%- set tot.amount_invoiced = tot.amount_invoiced + (po.amount_invoiced or 0) -%} {%- set tot.amount_paid = tot.amount_paid + (po.amount_paid or 0) -%} {%- set tot.po_amount_delivered = tot.po_amount_delivered + (po.po_amount_delivered or 0) -%} {%- set tot.amount_due = tot.amount_due + (po.amount_due or 0) -%} {%- if po.status == "Inactive" %}{% set tot.inactive = true %}{% endif -%} {%- endfor -%} {#- "Invoice Summary (all POs)" -- vendor-wide, ignores the table filters, exactly like the screen's card: Total Invoiced = every PO's amount_invoiced; Amount Due = that minus the vendor's Paid PO payments. -#} {%- set inv = namespace(invoiced=0, paid=0) -%} {%- for r in frappe.get_all("Procurement Orders", filters={"vendor": doc.name}, fields=["amount_invoiced"]) -%} {%- set inv.invoiced = inv.invoiced + (r.amount_invoiced or 0) -%} {%- endfor -%} {%- for r in frappe.get_all("Project Payments", filters={"vendor": doc.name, "document_type": "Procurement Orders", "status": "Paid"}, fields=["amount"]) -%} {%- set inv.paid = inv.paid + (r.amount or 0) -%} {%- endfor -%} {%- set amount_due_all = inv.invoiced - inv.paid -%} {#- Company header: the default GSTIN's billing address (a vendor spans projects). -#} {%- set default_gstin = "29ABFCS9095N1Z9" -%} {%- set company_name = "Nirmaan (Stratos Infra Technologies Pvt. Ltd.)" -%} {%- set logo_url = "https://stack.nirmaan.app/assets/nirmaan_stack/frontend/assets/logo-svg-BptBZTzQ.svg" -%} {%- set company_addr = "Billing address not configured (Check Project GST DocType)" -%} {%- set gst_name = frappe.db.get_value("Project GST", {"gstin": default_gstin}, "name") -%} {%- if gst_name -%} {%- set g = frappe.db.get_value("Project GST", gst_name, ["address", "city", "pincode", "state"], as_dict=True) -%} {%- set company_addr = [g.address, [g.city, g.pincode] | select | join("-"), g.state] | select | join(", ") -%} {%- endif -%} {#- Repeats on every page (wkhtmltopdf header). -#}
